shared_lines_and_weighted_dyadic_sums.cube_root_enclosures: exact rational upper and lower bounds with denominator 4096; no floating-point comparison

partial_wall_product_count.scope: Uniform partial count O(n*T^(4/3)*log(n+1)) for initial cells incident to an interior wall with primitive direction product at most T. Exact fiber recovery includes endpoints of collapsed edges. The known three-pole quotient has quadratically many interior cells whose every primitive wall product is Omega(n^2). No bound for all remaining cells, unrestricted G_3 improvement, new enumeration implementation or novelty certificate.

ordered_flag_interaction_controls.scope: Two fixed internal orders have a direct matroid-interleaving prior-art boundary. Three-list prefix ranks admit signed pair/triple max formulas, with at most 2*r^2 triple terms and O(r^2*log(r+1)) rank-oracle preprocessing after list compression. Uniform prefix rank already has exactly r^2 triple terms; ordinary three-pole quotient arithmetic verifies that prefix model after contracting the constant. This does not identify its full residue matroid with a uniform matroid. Any two-list region covers at most n states of its positive fan, so the quadratic large-wall subset requires Omega(n) such regions. No polylogarithmic cover, unrestricted G_3 bound, strongest-current or novelty certificate.

scope: Exact supporting checks for a uniform rational-shadow theorem and a three-variable upper bound. A partial wall-product count, explicit projection-fiber recovery and a uniform large-wall exception family are also checked. Fixed-list matching, signed three-list ranks and the obstruction to a small region cover are independently verified. These do not settle the sharp extremal target, establish current novelty, or imply an implemented running-time bound.
